text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, after training ended
and we were packing up...

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
—Yo, Kris S.
You done with training?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Then, come with me for a bit.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
The underclassmen were making quite a fuss.
Said you taught 'em everything from top to bottom.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: "Apparently their times improved drastically after receiving coaching, didn't they?"

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Why don't you let me have a taste
of that "coaching" of yours that everyone's talking about?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: —Savor the American flavors to your heart's content.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...Understood.
My knowledge and experience—I will gladly pass them on.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, looks like we got permission for our extracurricular lesson.
Well then, let's get started.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Yes. Let us do—our absolute best.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Symboli Kris S worked hard at
independent training with Sirius Symboli until late.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"...Like Umamusume, like Trainer, huh?
Their management is thorough as hell."

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Well, whatever.
If we pick another day, you'll hang out with me, right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Concerned about overtraining,
we decided to pass on independent training for the day.
